outcome: Beta-cell proliferation, differentiation, and insulin secretion modulation
cohort: The study included 21 pregnant women with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) and 10 non-diabetic control pregnant women.
finding: The study found upregulation of miR-330-3p in the plasma of GDM patients compared to non-diabetics, suggesting its potential to identify GDM patients with worse gestational diabetes outcomes.
mod_finding: The GDM-miR-330high subgroup exhibited a significantly higher rate of primary cesarean sections.
